Name: Frilly Smart Directory
Description: The Frilly local directory (frilly.ai): businesses, organizations and makers in Greater Madison, WI, plus the events they host. Every URL, flag, count and label the site shows is derived from the raw rows here.

Sites.Description: The directory product itself (one row: Frilly). Global settings that other tables read through a lookup, so nothing is hard-coded in a formula.

schema.name: Title
schema.Description: Brand name shown in the header and page titles.

schema.name: Tagline
schema.Description: The hero line on the home page.

schema.name: BaseUrl
schema.Description: Public origin, no trailing slash. Every absolute URL in the rulebook is derived from it.

schema.name: Today
schema.Description: The current date (YYYY-MM-DD) as the site sees it. Events compare their date to this to decide if they are upcoming. Bump it to move time forward.

schema.name: FeaturedLimit
schema.Description: How many featured listings the home page shows.

schema.name: JoinUrl
schema.Description: Where the 'Join Now' call to action points.

schema.name: CountOfCities
schema.Description: How many cities this site covers.

schema.name: CountOfListings
schema.Description: Total listings (businesses + organizations + individuals) on the site.

schema.name: CountOfEvents
schema.Description: Total events known to the site.

schema.name: CountOfPublishedListings
schema.Description: Listings that are live on the public site.

schema.name: IsLive
schema.Description: The site has something to show.

Cities.Description: A city the directory covers. The URL prefix (/wisconsin/madison) is derived here once and every listing and event reads it.

schema.name: Site
schema.Description: The site this city belongs to.

schema.name: PathPrefix
schema.Description: URL prefix every entity in this city hangs under.

schema.name: SiteBaseUrl
schema.Description: The site origin, pulled from Sites.

schema.name: DirectoryUrl
schema.Description: Absolute URL of this city's directory root.

schema.name: CountOfListings
schema.Description: All listings located in this city.

schema.name: CountOfUpcomingEvents
schema.Description: Events in this city on or after the site's Today.

schema.name: HasEvents
schema.Description: Whether the city page should show an events section.

schema.name: IsPrimaryMarket
schema.Description: A city with enough listings to be a headline market.

EntityTypes.Description: The three kinds of listing the site publishes, with the URL segment each uses (/b, /o, /i).

schema.name: PluralLabel
schema.Description: Plural display label used for section headings.

schema.name: Blurb
schema.Description: One-line description used on the directory landing page.

schema.name: ListPathSegment
schema.Description: The path piece inserted between the city prefix and the slug.

Categories.Description: Top-level category a listing belongs to (Food & Hospitality, Entertainment, ...).

schema.name: MenuLabel
schema.Description: Label with a live count for filters.

Subcategories.Description: Second-level category (Deli & Bakery under Food & Hospitality).

schema.name: FullTitle
schema.Description: Breadcrumb-style label used in listing cards.

schema.name: IsEmpty
schema.Description: A subcategory no listing uses (safe to retire).

Listings.Description: A business, organization or individual maker page on the public site. Raw fields are what the editor types; everything about URLs, completeness and event rollups is derived.

schema.name: City
schema.Description: City the listing is located in.

schema.name: Description
schema.Description: Long-form description shown on the detail page.

schema.name: Phone
schema.Description: Phone number as displayed; empty if unknown.

schema.name: Website
schema.Description: External website URL; empty if unknown.

schema.name: LogoUrl
schema.Description: Logo image URL; empty if none.

schema.name: IsFeatured
schema.Description: Shown in the home page 'Featured today' strip.

schema.name: LastUpdated
schema.Description: ISO timestamp of the last content change (from the source site).

schema.name: SourceId
schema.Description: The id the current site uses for this record (for reconciliation).

schema.name: MarkdownUrl
schema.Description: The AI-readable markdown twin of the page.

schema.name: JsonUrl
schema.Description: The machine-readable JSON twin of the page.

schema.name: HasCoordinates
schema.Description: Can be placed on a map.

schema.name: HasDescription
schema.Description: Has a real description, not a stub.

schema.name: CompletenessScore
schema.Description: 0-7: how many of the profile facets are filled in.
schema.formula: =IF({{HasPhone}}, 1, 0) + IF({{HasEmail}}, 1, 0) + IF({{HasWebsite}}, 1, 0) + IF({{HasAddress}}, 1, 0) + IF({{HasCoordinates}}, 1, 0) + IF({{HasLogo}}, 1, 0) + IF({{HasDescription}}, 1, 0)

schema.name: CompletenessPercent
schema.Description: CompletenessScore as a percentage for the admin dashboard.

schema.name: IsFeaturable
schema.Description: Eligible for the featured strip (published, complete, has a logo).

schema.name: IsFeaturedLive
schema.Description: Actually shows in 'Featured today': flagged AND eligible.

schema.name: CardLabel
schema.Description: The 'Food & Hospitality | Deli & Bakery' line under a card title.

schema.name: SearchText
schema.Description: Lower-cased haystack the search box matches against.

schema.name: IsVenue
schema.Description: Hosts events, so the detail page gets an events section.

data.Title: Danny Garwood & Company
data.Description:
Danny Garwood is a passionate blues guitarist based in Nashville, Tennessee, dedicated to preserving and evolving the blues tradition for future generations. Drawing inspiration from legends like Stevie Ray Vaughan, Jimi Hendrix, and John Mayer, Danny began his musical journey at age eight, quickly progressing to live performances by age eleven. His commitment to the genre is evident in his powerful guitar work and his mission to keep the blues alive.

A rising star in the blues scene, Danny has garnered significant recognition for his talent. He competed in the Dallas International Guitar Festival's '10 under 20' competition, earning third place as the youngest participant in 2023. His career highlights include a viral YouTube performance with Ally Venable, opening for her in major cities, and sharing the stage with blues icons Buddy Guy and Christone "Kingfish" Ingram at the historic Ryman Auditorium. Danny also actively mentors young musicians by hosting the youth blues jam at Ground Zero Blues Club in Clarksdale, MS.

With his band, Danny Garwood & Company, he performs electrifying blues shows across the country. His discography includes EPs like "50 FIFTY" and "Danny Garwood & Company," showcasing both original compositions and classic covers. Danny Garwood offers an authentic and dynamic blues experience, making him a compelling artist for venues and events seeking high-caliber musical entertainment.

data.Title: Warner Hodges
data.Description:
Warner E. Hodges is a highly respected and influential musician, guitarist, and songwriter based in Nashville, Tennessee. With a career spanning decades, he is best known as a founding member of the critically acclaimed Jason & The Scorchers, who were honored with the Americana Music Association Lifetime Achievement Award for Performance. Hodges' distinctive guitar work and energetic stage presence have made him a prominent figure in the rock and roll and Americana genres.

As a prolific artist, Warner E. Hodges leads his own projects, including The Warner E. Hodges Band and the Warner E. Hodges International Allstars, consistently releasing new material such as his recent albums "Absolutely" and "Soul Shaker." He is an active touring musician, performing extensively across Europe and participating in high-profile events like the Outlaw Country Cruise. His diverse musical engagements also include collaborations with bands such as Dan Baird & Homemade Sin, Drivin' n Cryin', and The Bluefields, alongside intimate solo acoustic performances that showcase his storytelling abilities.

data.Description:

Renowned for their captivating live shows, Feed The Dog offers a genre-defying musical experience driven by exceptional musicianship and creative improvisation. The band specializes in creating an engaging, community-focused atmosphere at every performance, connecting deeply with audiences through their original compositions and vibrant stage presence. Whether headlining major music festivals or performing intimate club sets, they consistently deliver top-tier entertainment.

Beyond live performances, the group is dedicated to fostering the local music community and supporting regional arts. By combining traditional acoustic roots with modern jam-band sensibilities, Feed The Dog provides an unforgettable sonic journey for music lovers of all generations, establishing themselves as one of Wisconsin's must-see live acts.

data.Title: Kyle Megna and The Monsons
data.Description:

Recognized as the Wisconsin Area Music Industry Alternative Rock/Rock Artist of the Year in both 2017 and 2018, with frontman Kyle Megna also earning Male Vocalist of the Year in 2018, they have established themselves as a significant force in the regional music scene. The band is composed of accomplished and charismatic musicians from diverse backgrounds, who consistently deliver professional and engaging shows.

Their distinctive musical style seamlessly weaves together elements of Rock, Jazz, Blues, Folk, and Pop, creating a magnetic and emotionally charged experience for listeners. The Monsoons are best experienced live, where they expertly feed off the energy of the crowd and each other, fostering a vibrant atmosphere. With an ever-growing following, they are dedicated to creating music that connects and inspires, embodying their belief that "Music heals us all."

Kyle Megna and The Monsoons are active performers, regularly appearing at prominent events and venues across Wisconsin, including Summerfest, Waterfest, and the Mile of Music Festival. Their commitment to creativity and emotional depth ensures a memorable musical journey for all who encounter their artistry.

data.Title: Mastercraft Ventures
data.Description:
Mastercraft Ventures is a Beloit, Wisconsin-based venture capital firm dedicated to fostering disruptive technologies and innovations, primarily within Southern Wisconsin and the broader state. They are committed to building lasting relationships with entrepreneurs, offering more than just capital by leveraging their team's extensive operational experience and network to drive sustainable success for early-stage startups. This approach ensures that as startups thrive, so does the local community.

Led by founder Mason Cook, an experienced operator who has navigated the "founder's roller coaster," Mastercraft Ventures provides invaluable support beyond financial investment. The firm focuses on Idea to Seed stage companies across agnostic industries, with a particular interest in Software, Hardware, and Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) technologies. They recognize Wisconsin's unique advantages, including lower business costs and a strong position in key innovation sectors, making it an ideal environment for groundbreaking ventures to flourish. Their strategic investment committee further strengthens their ability to support portfolio companies.

data.Title: Badger Farms LLC
data.Description:

Since 2006, it has been a popular choice for barn weddings, receptions, corporate meetings, strategic planning retreats, and a variety of special events including birthdays, anniversaries, and family reunions. data.Title: Very Important Pets
data.Description:

Relocating from North Dakota with a vision to create a top-tier pet care center, VIP is dedicated to providing a safe, fun, and enriching experience for every animal. Their mission centers on delivering exceptional pet boarding and daycare services, while also integrating pet owners into the learning process through valuable training programs.

What sets VIP apart is its commitment to fostering lifelong skills and behaviors that contribute to happy and healthy pet families. Owner Kori Golberg, a Certified Dog Obedience Trainer with a Bachelor's in Animal Science and Business, brings over eight years of professional dog experience, alongside certifications in Pet First Aid and CPR. The facility offers comprehensive training, leveraging Kori's expertise and even the unique 'Matching Playstyles' of their own dog, Murphy, to help pets develop appropriate social skills. From playful daycare to comfortable boarding for both dogs and cats, VIP ensures every pet receives personalized, expert care.

data.Title: Paradise Paws Camp & Resort, LLC
data.Description:
Paradise Paws Camp & Resort, LLC, located in Windsor, WI, minutes from Madison, offers exceptional kennel-free boarding, doggy daycare, and full-service grooming. Since opening in November 2019, their mission has been to provide a stress-free, safe, and loving environment for every pet. The facility boasts over 9,000 sq. ft. of indoor play space and six large, securely fenced outdoor areas, ensuring ample room for dogs to socialize and play. A key differentiator is their commitment to continuous, 24-hour human supervision, 365 days a year, regardless of weather, ensuring pets are never left unattended.

The resort prides itself on its highly trained and certified staff, who undergo rigorous training in dog body language, group management, and canine health, including a minimum of 40 hours of one-on-one training before supervising groups. Dogs are carefully grouped by size, energy, and play style, maintaining low staff-to-dog ratios to closely monitor appropriate play. Owner Karen Schultz brings extensive experience, having founded Key to Happiness Rescue, which successfully placed over 3,000 dogs, and her passion for animal welfare is evident in the resort's operations. The grooming team provides individualized, stress-reducing care by focusing on one dog at a time. Paradise Paws Camp & Resort, LLC is dedicated to ensuring every animal feels loved and comfortable, creating a true "paradise" for pets and peace of mind for their owners.

data.Title: Badger Popcorn
data.Description: Badger Popcorn History  *Harvey’s Days Woman working a popcorn or cotton candy machine sometime in the 1950sBadger Popcorn came about as a result of providing a helping hand to the pioneers of the modern concession industry. Harvey O’Neil was one of those pioneers. Harvey operated a popcorn wagon in the early 1940s. He got his start by playing fairs in Marshfield and Madison, Wisconsin. Harvey got into the habit of bringing along some extra supplies and selling to the other concessionaires at the fairs.   By 1948, a “few extras” turned into a small popcorn supply company, and Harvey began stocking 50 lb. bags of popcorn for the first time. Five years later, Badger Popcorn was incorporated in the state of Wisconsin. Then in 1958 Harvey expanded again and became a full stocking dealer of Gold Medal Products, then and now the #1 manufacturer of concession equipment and supplies in the world. Purchases from Gold Medal that year totaled a mere $484.00! With Gold Medal on board, Badger Popcorn became Wisconsin’s first full-line concession supply company.  *The Birth of a New Company Woman delivering cotton candy to a car sometime in the 1950sIt started with a chance phone call in 1978. Dick Virnoche, having spent 19 years in sales and sales management for a major pharmaceutical company, decided a career change was best for his family and became a stockbroker. It was in this context that he met and began working with Harvey O’Neil. Harvey was in his seventies and was planning on selling Badger Popcorn. As Dick learned more about the business, the spark that ignites the imagination of every entrepreneur burst into flame. Less than a year later, and with the help of his wife Ellen and sons Tim and Tom, Badger Popcorn became the Virnoche family business.  Passing the Torch By 1993, Dick’s hard work and innovative thinking had helped the company double in size twice since 1979. His sons, having been given more authority in the running of the business, were ready to step in and continue the family tradition. On October 1, 1993 Tim and Tom bought Badger Popcorn from their Mom and Dad. “The Boys” have continued to do business the way their parents taught them — treat everyone fairly and honestly, provide the best products at a good value and deliver excellent customer service.   On October 1st, 2021, in the midst of a seemingly unending global pandemic, the third generation of the Virnoche family took the reins. Tom’s youngest son Matt joined the company in April, 2018. Matt immersed himself in every facet of company operations and became it’s new owner and next member of the Virnoche family to lead the company into the future.  Our Vision of the Future Badger Popcorn is a traditional “bricks and mortar” company that recognizes the role technology can play in helping us better serve our customers. We don’t believe any web site will be a good substitute for the knowledge that our staff can share with a Customer, but we do understand that it’s a great starting point for gathering information. If you’re not completely comfortable in making a purchase, give us a call and we’ll share with you a little of the expertise we’ve picked up over the last 45 years.  At Badger Popcorn, we know our success is tied to yours… and the better we do our job, the more successful we’ll both become. We have invested heavily in both our physical plant and in finding and keeping the best people in the industry. Our dedicated team of professionals are focused on this single goal for the future:  To become an indispensable partner to our customers through excellence in product knowledge, service after the sale and through a consistent and ethical approach to doing business.

data.Title: Ensodata
data.Description:
EnsoData, based in Madison, Wisconsin, is a pioneering healthcare AI company dedicated to transforming clinical waveform data into actionable insights. They develop FDA-cleared Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) solutions that significantly enhance the accuracy, efficiency, and affordability of healthcare, with a primary focus on sleep medicine. Their innovative platforms, EnsoSleep and EnsoHST, leverage advanced artificial intelligence to automate sleep study scoring and facilitate comprehensive multi-night home sleep testing, respectively.

EnsoSleep provides substantial time savings for clinicians by automating the analysis of polysomnograms (PSGs) and home sleep apnea tests (HSATs), while EnsoHST offers comfortable, multi-signal home testing devices to streamline the diagnosis of sleep disorders. Complementary tools like Celeste+ and Therapy Track further optimize data collection and enable long-term therapy monitoring for various treatments. EnsoData's mission is to address the significant population of undiagnosed sleep apnea patients and alleviate the workload on healthcare professionals.

Beyond sleep, EnsoData envisions a future where its waveform AI can unlock dormant clinical data to detect and manage a broad spectrum of conditions, including heart disease, diabetes, seizure disorders, and neurodegenerative diseases. By empowering clinicians with intelligent tools, EnsoData aims to improve patient outcomes, expand access to essential health services, and make healthcare more accessible globally.

data.Title: Herbiery Taproom
data.Description:
We began with an imagination fed by plants & books.
The seed of Herbiery, and hop free beer, whirled on the salty, gusting breeze over Homer, AK to land in Nia’s imagination. The seed took root. Between guiding canoe trips in the Swan Lake wilderness, leading fat tire bike trips on the beaches, and landscaping in the mountains across the bay, Nia was thankful for 18 to 23 hours of daylight. Free time was for two things: getting lost in the world of the written word or blurring the lines of where her self ended and the tidal zones, forests, and fireweed filled meadows began. 

It was there, between those two points, that she discovered the book, “Sacred and Herbal Healing Beers,” by Stephen Harrod Buhner. Many of the plants described grew around Homer. Nia needed to close the gap between “plants” and “beer.” The only way to do that would be to make it themselves. Winter drove them out of Alaska and to a surprisingly rural New Jersey to live with their parents. Production began and so did education. 

After completing three Herbalism certifications from the Herbal Academy of New England and brewing 17 unique brews, Nia was ready for the next step. With a deafening demand for more echoing off of her friends, family, and whoever tried these beers, Nia moved to Madison, WI. A homecoming of sorts as Nia was born in Stevens Point. Herbiery easily found a home in the verdant valleys, oaken hills, and marsh-ringed lakes of Wisconsin.

data.Title: Image Mover MD
data.Description:
Image Mover MD, based in Madison, Wisconsin, specializes in simplifying healthcare imaging workflows through innovative technology. They offer a patient-centric platform designed to connect and optimize existing imaging systems within healthcare organizations. Their solutions enable secure, HIPAA-compliant capture of patient images directly into Electronic Health Records (EHR) and Picture Archiving and Communication Systems (PACS/VNA), ensuring no data is left on mobile devices. This streamlines processes for various scenarios, from capturing a patient's rash with a smartphone to integrating bedside ultrasounds and seamlessly uploading outside images.

The platform addresses critical business challenges by enhancing financial performance, improving connectivity, and elevating both patient and provider experiences. Image Mover MD helps reduce operational costs through workflow automation, increases revenue by capturing previously unrealized billings, and ensures compliance to avoid penalties. By connecting disparate imaging processes and leveraging existing system investments, they facilitate efficient image sharing across diverse care settings. Ultimately, their technology drives provider satisfaction by automating manual tasks and improves the overall patient care journey through better access to comprehensive imaging data.

data.Title: Just Bakery
data.Description:
Just Bakery in Madison, WI, is more than just a bakery; it's a transformative educational and vocational training program. Dedicated to empowering individuals facing significant barriers to employment—including homelessness, criminal conviction history, and lack of work experience—Just Bakery provides comprehensive culinary and hospitality skills. Students engage with the National Restaurant Association’s "ManageFirst" curriculum, covering restaurant management, supervision, cost control, nutrition, and ServSafe certification. This rigorous training enables participants to earn college credits and gain direct entry into Madison College's Culinary Program, setting them on a path to sustainable careers.

Beyond the classroom, students gain invaluable hands-on experience in a commercial kitchen, learning baking techniques and developing customer service, sales, and marketing skills through real-world interactions. The program's unique social enterprise model ensures that all proceeds from the sale of its delicious baked goods—ranging from artisanal breads and pastries to cookies and pies—are reinvested directly back into the program. This allows Just Bakery to hire its own graduates, fostering a cycle of empowerment and community support. By choosing Just Bakery, customers not only enjoy high-quality products but also contribute to a vital mission of creating a more just and equitable community in Dane County.

data.Title: L.R. Ingersoll Wonders of Physics Museum
data.Description:
The L.R. Ingersoll Wonders of Physics Museum, nestled within the University of Wisconsin–Madison Physics Department, holds the distinction of being the oldest hands-on physics museum in North America. Conceived in 1917 and fully established in 1918 by Professors Snow and Ingersoll, it has consistently provided a unique and engaging educational experience, transforming complex physics concepts into accessible, interactive exhibits. The museum's recent renaming reflects its integral role in UW–Madison's broader physics outreach efforts, including the celebrated "Wonders of Physics" annual and traveling shows.

Featuring over 65 rotating exhibits, the museum invites visitors of all ages to explore physical phenomena, from fundamental mechanics to cutting-edge modern physics, through direct, tactile engagement. A key differentiator is that many exhibits are uniquely designed by UW–Madison faculty and staff, then meticulously constructed by departmental shops and students. This collaborative approach ensures a truly hands-on and kid-friendly environment, fostering curiosity and scientific exploration by putting physics directly into the hands of its young visitors.

data.Title: Riset Resiliency
data.Description:
Riset Resiliency, based in Madison, Wisconsin, is dedicated to reducing suffering by helping individuals co-regulate their nervous systems. Founded by Sarah Giencke, a Certified Nervous System and Resilience Coach specializing in TRE® (Tension & Trauma Releasing Exercises), the consultancy empowers clients to reclaim balance and peace in their lives. Sarah's approach is rooted in understanding the deep connection between physical trauma responses and environmental impacts, including adverse work cultures.

Riset Resiliency utilizes TRE®, a simple yet innovative series of exercises designed to release deep muscular patterns of stress, tension, and trauma. This somatic tool, combined with mindfulness and meditative practices, offers a wide array of benefits, including decreased stress and anxiety, reduced chronic pain, improved sleep, increased resilience, and enhanced relationships. The vision is to normalize neurogenic tremoring as a powerful self-regulation technique.

Services include personalized private sessions, ranging from introductory to advanced packages, allowing individuals to deepen their relationship with tremoring. Riset also offers virtual and in-person small group classes for community support, as well as workshops for organizations to educate leaders and employees on resilience, regulation, and trauma-informed practices, fostering positive culture change at scale.

data.Title: Self Health Fund
data.Description:
Self Fund Health, based in Madison, Wisconsin, revolutionizes employer-sponsored healthcare by offering a transparent, cost-effective, and employee-centric health plan. Moving beyond traditional insurance models, SFH empowers employers to "stop buying insurance and start buying healthcare" by directly addressing the inflated costs and misaligned incentives prevalent in the industry. Their integrated solution is designed to significantly reduce healthcare expenditures for businesses while providing exceptional value and $0 out-of-pocket costs for employees who utilize preferred providers.

The core of Self Fund Health's offering includes $0 Direct Primary Care, dedicated Personal Nurse Navigators, and a curated network of over 327 preferred providers offering services at or below 200% of Medicare rates. They also feature bundled surgery pricing, transparent pharmacy benefits with 100% rebate pass-through, and real-time savings reports, ensuring complete financial visibility for employers. By aligning incentives and focusing on value-based care, SFH helps businesses achieve sustainable healthcare costs and high member satisfaction, demonstrating average per-member-per-month reductions of $173.

Self Fund Health provides a complete plan replacement, not just an add-on, ensuring employees retain access to broad PPO networks while being guided towards high-quality, cost-efficient care. This innovative approach, backed by strong clinical navigation and a commitment to transparency, makes them a leader in transforming healthcare for employers across Wisconsin, Minnesota, Iowa, Illinois, and Michigan.

data.Title: Spinning Handiworks
data.Description:
We are an Indigenous-owned family business based in Madison, Wisconsin, offering handmade products from across the Americas and beyond. For over 20 years, we’ve proudly shared the timeless artistry of our culture while living far from our llakta (homeland) in Ecuador.

 

 We are the Kichwa-Otavalo, the Mindalaes people, who are known for spreading our art, music, and handmade products wherever we go. For us, this is not a business; this is a way of life. By sharing and trading our own handmade products, we keep alive our aboriginal wisdom and strengthen our Indigenous roots in spite of being thousands of miles away from our mother country.

 

 We offer all this with a great collection of colorful shawls, warm alpaca sweaters, and genuine articles like ponchos, rebozos, dresses, and trousers made of pure alpaca and sheep wool. We trade in handmade jewelry—necklaces, earrings, bracelets—made from natural stones, beads, leather, and seeds like tawa. We also have well-designed bags like backpacks, purses, and wallets made of leather, wool, and other green products.

 

 While most of our products are hand-made by our friends and family, as well as the Ecuadorian artisan community, we also deal with our family friends from India and Thailand. They give us handmade clothing articles, such as dresses, pants, and blouses, that are hand-worn by their own families and communities.

 

 Every product we offer carries with it a history of resilience, culture, and belonging. To purchase from our family business is not just to acquire a product—you're also acquiring a legacy of craftsmanship, sustainability, and pride in Indigenous culture. Yupaychani, thank you for being here and for assisting us in keeping our traditions alive.

data.Title: The Orpheum Theater
data.Description:

Today, The Orpheum Theater remains Madison's premier destination for live entertainment, offering a diverse calendar of concerts, comedy shows, and theatrical productions. Its blend of historic grandeur and modern amenities provides an unparalleled experience for patrons seeking world-class performances in a truly magnificent setting.

data.Title: Wilson's Bar & Grill
data.Description: 40On November 19, 1985 Wilson’s was born.  Brother and sister, Randy and Sandi Wilson (now Borowski) opened Wilson’s Bar and Grill (although the grill did not happen until 1987). In 1988, Wilson’s teamed up with Bullseye Mary, the premier vendor in the Midwest (maybe the U.S.) to become the dominant sports bar in the area.  We sponsored numerous State and National Champs throughout the years.  Wilson’s has sponsored over a 1000 of pool, darts, softball, bowling, kickball, rugby and everything else – teams.  As the years went on and bars changed, Wilson’s turned into even more of a neighborhood sports bar, with much more food offerings and more of a family bar.  Every day Wilson’s has food specials made by Sandi; soups, chili and an extensive food menu.   All the family, kids, grandkids, parents, relatives have lent a hand at one time or another to make Wilson’s what it is and will be for a long time.  Born and raised blocks from the bar, Sandi and Randy will continue to be lower-Eastside business owners for many years to come.    November 19, 2025 will be the first day of our “40th” year.  We hope the next 40 (or more) years will be as successful as the first.

Beyond their studio recordings, Horace Greene is celebrated for their dynamic live performances, having played approximately 200 shows at notable venues and festivals such as Milwaukee's Summer Soulstice, Mile of Music, and Mid West Music Fest. They have shared stages with diverse acts like Post Animal and Bombino. The band also demonstrates a strong commitment to visual storytelling through their music videos and the innovative "Rollin' with Roland" short-form video series, which even led to an official collaboration with the Roland company.

Looking ahead, Horace Greene continues to evolve, having recently released the singles "Nighttime Boi" and "Cream" in anticipation of a new full-length album slated for 2026, featuring their latest track "Hush." Their dedication to crafting bold, magnetic songwriting and engaging with their audience through various creative mediums solidifies their position as a vibrant force in the music scene.

data.Title: FNÜ
data.Description:
Bringing an electric fusion of deep house, melodic techno, and infectious energy, DJ FNÜ has become a cornerstone of the Madison music scene. Known for her ability to read a room and transform any space into a high-vibration dance floor, she doesn’t just play sets—she curates experiences. Whether she’s commanding the booth at a packed downtown club or setting the mood for an underground warehouse session, FNÜ’s signature sound is defined by driving rhythms and soulful, unexpected transitions that keep the Midwest moving.

Her approach to electronic music is deeply rooted in the community, blending a polished, professional technique with a raw, authentic passion for the culture. Drawing inspiration from the global house scene while remaining fiercely loyal to her Wisconsin roots, she has earned a reputation as one of the most versatile and engaging selectors in the region. Every performance is an invitation to get lost in the groove, marked by a seamless flow that bridges the gap between classic house heritage and the cutting edge of modern electronic production.

Beyond the decks, FNÜ is a force of positivity and connection, using her platform to elevate the local scene and bring people together through the universal language of the beat. For those looking for a DJ who brings both technical precision and an undeniable "vibe," FNÜ is the answer. Follow her journey as she continues to push the boundaries of the Madison sound, one heavy bassline and uplifting melody at a time.

data.Title: Kyle Freund
data.Description: Kyle Freund is Senior Communications Manager at Heifer International USA, the US branch of Heifer International, a global organization working to end hunger and poverty, and care for the Earth. Previously, Freund worked with Solidaridad Network and managed a communications consultancy working with international NGOs and mission-driven organizations and companies.

data.Title: Lynda & the Zeros
data.Description:
Lynda & the ZEROS is a vibrant R&B/Soul and Funk band based in Madison, Wisconsin, established in 2016. Renowned for their infectious grooves and high-energy performances, they consistently captivate audiences, inspiring an irresistible urge to dance. The band's core mission is to forge a deep connection with listeners through rhythmic and soulful music that transcends traditional genre boundaries, making every show a memorable experience.

As a top-ranked local R&B/Soul act on ReverbNation, Lynda & the ZEROS has garnered a significant following, boasting thousands of song and video plays and over a thousand dedicated fans. Their diverse repertoire features compelling original compositions like "Too Hot" and "URTHE1," alongside dynamic interpretations of popular covers such as KT Tunstall's "Black Horse (In A Cherry Tree)."

Whether gracing stages at Madison's Overture or other prominent venues across Wisconsin, Lynda & the ZEROS delivers a powerful and engaging musical journey. Their sound, drawing inspiration from artists like Jamie Cullum and local R&B/Soul talent Joey B. Banks, blends sophisticated influences with raw, soulful power, creating a unique and electrifying atmosphere perfect for any event.

data.Title: Midwestern Stetsons
data.Description: Midwestern Stetsons are a Classic Country band comprised of Isaac DeBroux-Slone (Disq), James Strelow (Spine Stealers), David Havas (Shauncey Ali Quartet), and Stu Manley (Disq). Brought together by a mutual love for country music, this quartet is excited to bring the sounds of Buck Owens, George Jones, and other golden era country greats to the stages of Madison, WI. Show starts at 5pm. No cover. Join us next week on Sunday April 12th

data.Title: Olivia Barrow Communications
data.Description:
Olivia Barrow Communications, based in Madison, Wisconsin, specializes in B2B content marketing and SEO strategy, helping medium-sized companies transform their websites into powerful sales pipelines. Leveraging over a decade of content creation experience and a strong journalism background, Olivia brings unique interviewing skills to develop and execute strategies that generate leads from search engines. Her services include comprehensive SEO audits, tailored content strategy and execution, high-quality content creation, and personalized coaching and training for marketing teams.

Olivia works as an extension of in-house teams, providing expert guidance to build scalable, results-driven content strategies. She assists businesses looking to invest in SEO for the first time, or those needing to rectify previous ineffective efforts. By focusing on holistic strategies that address audience needs and competitive advantages, Olivia Barrow Communications ensures content not only ranks but also deeply resonates, positioning brands as industry authorities and driving sustainable organic growth. Clients benefit from a flexible engagement model designed to elevate their brand and secure a steady stream of qualified leads.

data.Title: Orquesta SalSoul Del Mad
data.Description:
Orquesta SalSoul Del Mad is Madison, Wisconsin's premiere Latin fusion band, renowned for pushing boundaries and celebrating diversity through music and education. This vibrant 15-piece ensemble combines the fiery rhythms of Salsa with the soulful grooves of Soul, creating electrifying performances that captivate audiences of all ages and backgrounds.

The Orquesta is composed of some of Madison's finest local musicians, reflecting the city's rich international diversity. Their commitment to community building, creating memorable experiences, and uplifting voices has earned them significant recognition, including being voted Best Latin Performer by MAMA (Madison Area Music Award) and receiving multiple WAMI (Wisconsin Area Music Industry) award nominations in 2022, 2023, and 2024.

Dedicated to both original compositions and dynamic covers, Orquesta SalSoul Del Mad delivers soulful performances, heartfelt vocals, and an undeniable stage energy. They aim to spark meaningful conversations and empower the next generation of music lovers, making them an exceptional choice for any event seeking passionate and professional artistic engagement.

data.Title: Peace Love Hope
data.Description:
Peace Love Hope is a dynamic funk-rock-reggae fusion trio based in Madison, Wisconsin. Originally formed in Racine in 1989 under the name "Fruit Salad," the band has a rich history spanning several decades. After a significant three-decade hiatus, Peace Love Hope has triumphantly reunited, bringing their seasoned musical talent and a fresh, invigorated perspective to the contemporary music scene.

With a renewed passion for creating and performing, Peace Love Hope delivers a unique blend of genres, captivating audiences with their distinctive sound. Their music reflects years of experience and a deep understanding of funk, rock, and reggae, seamlessly weaving these elements into compelling tracks. The trio is dedicated to sharing their revitalized artistry, offering listeners a fresh and engaging musical experience that bridges their storied past with an exciting future. They are actively releasing new music, showcasing their enduring creativity and commitment to their craft.

data.Title: Phrequency
data.Description: Phrequency is an innovative music producer from Wisconsin. He is known for throwing high energy shows along with making high energy tracks. After graduating from Icon Collective School of Music in LA, Phrequency has gone above and beyond to find his sound and to give the audience the best experience imaginable at shows.

data.Title: Phun
data.Description:
Phun is a premier Wisconsin-based Phish tribute and jamband, led by founding guitarist and musical director Mike Scieszinski since 2009. Comprising Mason Aumunstal on bass, Lucas Trilling on keys, and Paul Westfahl on drums, the quartet is dedicated to mastering the intricate compositions and improvisational spirit of Phish. Their performances are known for blending faithful renditions of Phish hits with constant jamming and experimental exploration, showcasing the high level of musicianship required.

With over 16 years of experience, Phun has developed unique productions, including a 2014 touring show of Phish's original musical "Gamehendge" and a full-album performance of "A Live One" for Halloween 2024. They also host the popular Annual Hippy X-mas event in Madison every December. Phun has graced stages at major festivals like Summerfest, opening for Dark Star Orchestra and sharing the stage with Joe Russo’s Almost Dead. From festivals to private parties, Phun delivers an authentic Phish experience, providing fans in Madison and beyond with an accessible way to celebrate the music.

data.Title: The Rousers
data.Description: The Rousers have been rocking audiences for over 35 years. A Madison " must see" when they play. Frank( Harmonica, vocals), Ernie ( Guitar, Vocals), Don (Keyboard), Frank Q ( Bass, Vocals) and Lee ( Drums). Approximately 5 years ago they permanently added Dave Benton (Spooner,Waterdogs) as an additional member on Guitar!! They are known for their high energy sound that is all their own. Known for their Original songs like "Cheatin' and Drinkin', and" Ride Free or Die" and some great covers of bands like The Beatfarmers, The Blasters, and more.

data.Title: Steely Dane
data.Description:
Steely Dane is Madison, Wisconsin's premier Steely Dan tribute band, renowned for faithfully reproducing the complex and sophisticated music of Steely Dan and Donald Fagen. Comprising fourteen of the Midwest's finest jazz and rock musicians, this award-winning ensemble delivers an energetic live-show experience that captures the essence of the original band. They meticulously recreate Steely Dan's touring configuration, featuring a four-piece horn section and two background singers, ensuring an authentic and powerful sound.

Dedicated to both hits and deep cuts, Steely Dane's performances often include complete album renditions, delighting both long-time fans and new audiences. Their commitment to musical excellence and vibrant stage presence has earned them multiple awards for best tribute band. As Madison Magazine noted, "It’s a big band with a big sound, and it’s damn near perfect," making Steely Dane a must-see act for anyone who appreciates the unique blend of jazz, rock, and R&B that defines Steely Dan's iconic songbook.

data.Title: The Ham n' Eggers
data.Description:
The Ham n' Eggers are a Madison, Wisconsin-based musical ensemble renowned for their captivating blend of bluegrass-infused Americana. Formerly known as the Grouvin Family String Band, this talented group distinguishes itself through a strong emphasis on intricate vocal harmonies, creating a rich and authentic sound that resonates with audiences. Their performances showcase a dynamic interplay of traditional and contemporary influences, delivered with passion and precision.

The band features Annie Emmenegger on guitar and vocals, Tim Haub contributing guitar, mandolin, and vocals, Max Winkels on banjo, mandolin, and vocals, and Doug DeRosa anchoring the sound on bass and vocals. This diverse instrumentation, combined with their collective vocal prowess, allows The Ham n' Eggers to craft engaging arrangements that highlight both their individual talents and their cohesive musical vision. They offer a vibrant and memorable live music experience, inviting listeners to immerse themselves in their unique take on Americana.

data.Title: The Periodicals
data.Description:
The Periodicals are a dynamic nine-piece band based in Madison and Milwaukee, Wisconsin, renowned for their inventive fusion of northern soul, classic R&B, and alternative rock. This British/American ensemble delivers a soulful and searching sound, characterized by powerful guitars, vibrant horns, intricate keyboards, and sensational vocals. Their unique blend creates an irresistible energy that compels audiences to tap their feet and sing along, while also offering moments of unexpected musical depth.

Earning rave reviews for their tight and energetic live performances, The Periodicals skillfully navigate a rich catalog of original material imbued with a classic feel, alongside their distinctive interpretations of iconic northern soul tracks. Whether gracing festival stages or intimate downtown venues, the band consistently "rocks the house," showcasing the collective talent of its members, including acclaimed musicians like Nikko Murphy, Steve Rosenblum, and Jamill Shaw. They are a prominent fixture in the Wisconsin music scene, known for their captivating shows and commitment to sharing their passion for music.

data.Title: VO5
data.Description:
VO5 is a vibrant, high-energy band based in Madison, Wisconsin, dedicated to making audiences dance with their infectious disco and dance music. Comprising nine talented musicians, including sax, drums, trumpet, vocals, guitar, keyboard, bass, and percussion, VO5 delivers a full and dynamic sound that guarantees a lively atmosphere at any event. Their unique blend of instruments and collective passion for dance originality sets them apart in the local music scene.

Specializing in live performances, VO5 is available for event bookings, promising an unforgettable experience where "there will be tons of dancing." They even offer a 100% money-back guarantee on this promise, underscoring their confidence in their ability to get any crowd moving. With a focus on delivering pure, unadulterated fun, VO5 ensures that every performance is a celebration of rhythm and movement, inviting everyone to embrace the joy of disco. Their commitment to engaging their audience makes them a premier choice for entertainment in Madison and beyond.

data.Title: 100state
data.Description:
100state is a premier coworking and entrepreneurial space located in the heart of Madison, Wisconsin, dedicated to fostering a vibrant community of problem solvers, creatives, and innovators. Established in 2012 as a nonprofit organization, 100state has become a hub for startups, freelancers, and remote workers, offering an inspiring environment that nurtures collaboration and creativity. With an array of membership options, including hot desks, dedicated desks, and private offices, 100state provides flexible workspace solutions tailored to various work styles, all complemented by essential amenities such as high-speed internet, conference rooms, and communal areas filled with local art.

At 100state, members benefit from a dynamic ecosystem that promotes networking, professional development, and community engagement through regular events, workshops, and collaborative opportunities. The space not only supports individual productivity but also encourages partnerships that drive innovation and address local challenges. By prioritizing wellness and creativity, 100state stands out as a supportive environment where entrepreneurs and creatives can thrive, making it an ideal choice for those looking to make meaningful connections and elevate their work.

data.Title: 211 Wisconsin
data.Description:
211 Wisconsin is a vital statewide resource connecting individuals and families to essential community services. Operating 24/7, 365 days a year, this comprehensive service offers multiple accessible ways to seek help, including dialing 211, texting a ZIP code, online chat, or searching their extensive database. Trained community resource specialists provide personalized guidance, helping callers navigate complex needs such as food insecurity, utility assistance, housing support, mental health services, substance use treatment, and domestic violence resources.

With six regional centers across Wisconsin, 211 specialists utilize a database of over 12,000 agencies and networks to pinpoint local services. They ensure callers receive not just information, but also clear next steps to access the support they need. Beyond direct referrals, 211 Wisconsin also offers specialized resources like the Addiction Recovery Helpline, mental health screenings, and information for local emergencies, all available in over 180 languages. It stands as a trusted, comprehensive, and accessible lifeline for all Wisconsinites.

data.Title: AARP
data.Description:
AARP in Madison, WI serves as a vital resource and advocate for individuals aged 50 and over, empowering them to live their best lives. This organization champions the interests of older Americans through robust advocacy efforts, influencing policy on critical issues such as Social Security, Medicare, and affordable healthcare. Beyond advocacy, AARP provides a wealth of information and tools designed to help members navigate various life stages, including financial planning, career development, health and wellness, and family caregiving.

Members in Madison, WI, and across the nation, gain access to a comprehensive suite of benefits, including exclusive discounts on travel, dining, insurance, and technology. AARP also fosters community engagement through local events, workshops, and volunteer opportunities, connecting individuals and offering practical support. With a commitment to enhancing the quality of life for its members, AARP offers resources that promote physical and mental well-being, financial security, and social connection, ensuring a fulfilling experience for the 50-plus demographic.

data.Title: Aging & Disability Resource Center
data.Description:
The Aging and Disability Resource Center (ADRC) of Dane County serves as a vital "one-stop shop" in Madison, WI, offering comprehensive information and support for older adults, individuals with disabilities, and their families and caregivers. Dedicated to empowering residents, the ADRC provides unbiased guidance on a wide array of topics, helping individuals navigate complex decisions related to living arrangements, care needs, and funding options. Their knowledgeable Information and Assistance Specialists offer personalized consultations, ensuring that choices align with personal values, resources, and preferences.

The ADRC is the primary access point for understanding Wisconsin’s long-term care programs and applying for public benefits. They offer crucial information on subjects such as adaptive equipment, Alzheimer's support, in-home care, housing options, Medicare, Medicaid, Social Security, and transition services for youth. Committed to respecting individual rights and dignity, all services provided by the ADRC are free and accessible to all Dane County residents, regardless of income or assets, fostering independence and well-being within the community.

data.Title: American Legion Post 501
data.Description:
American Legion Post 501, known as Severson-Cairns Post 501, is a vibrant veteran organization in Madison, Wisconsin, proudly operating under the motto "The Action Post: Veterans Still Serving America." Dedicated to upholding the American Legion's core values, Post 501 serves as a vital hub for veterans, their families, and the wider community. The post actively engages in programs and services that support national, department, and local veteran initiatives, ensuring continued advocacy and assistance for those who have served.

Beyond direct veteran support, American Legion Post 501 fosters community spirit and patriotism. They provide essential services such as a convenient dropbox for unserviceable United States flags, promoting respectful flag disposal. The post regularly hosts membership meetings, executive committee gatherings, and in-person buddy checks, creating a strong network of camaraderie and mutual support among its members. Through these activities, Post 501 reinforces its commitment to service, community engagement, and the enduring welfare of veterans in Madison and beyond.

data.Title: Animal Control
data.Description:
Animal Control in Madison, WI, is provided by the dedicated Animal Services Officers of Public Health Madison & Dane County. These officers play a crucial role in safeguarding both the community and animal welfare. Their primary responsibilities include responding to calls concerning animal bites, managing stray animals, and investigating animal welfare concerns such as cruelty or neglect. They also actively educate the public on responsible animal care and practices for staying safe around animals, including rabies prevention.

The services extend to urgent situations like handling aggressive animals, addressing domestic animals running loose, and dealing with sick or injured stray domestic animals. They also manage rabies quarantines and testing, and intervene with wildlife that poses an immediate threat to public health or safety. For non-urgent matters, such as general inquiries about animal health, accumulation of animal waste, or educational resources, the Animal Services team offers comprehensive support. By addressing these diverse animal-related issues, Animal Control contributes significantly to enhancing, protecting, and promoting the health and well-being of all residents and their environment in Madison and Dane County.

data.Title: Area Agency On Aging-Dane County
data.Description:
The Area Agency on Aging of Dane County is dedicated to empowering individuals aged 60 and older, along with their families, to access essential services that support independent living within their homes and communities. This organization serves as a vital resource, offering both short-term assistance, such as enrollment in prescription drug programs, and long-term support, including ongoing case management for those with chronic health conditions.

As a key component of the national Aging Network, the AAA of Dane County provides a comprehensive array of community-based services. These include congregate and home-delivered meals, robust caregiver support programs, personalized case management, and expert assistance with benefit-related inquiries. Many of these locally delivered services operate on a donation basis, ensuring accessibility for all eligible residents. The agency also plays a crucial role in planning and policy development for programs funded by the Older Americans Act and state supplemental funding, guided by an active Advisory Council that ensures services reflect local needs.

data.Title: ARTS for ALL Wisconsin
data.Description:
ARTS for ALL Wisconsin is a dedicated statewide arts organization based in Madison, WI, committed to enriching the lives of children and adults with disabilities. Since its incorporation in 1985, and evolving from its roots as a Very Special Arts Affiliate Network member, the organization has consistently delivered comprehensive and in-depth arts programming. Its mission is to expand the capabilities, confidence, and quality of life for individuals with disabilities across Wisconsin through engaging experiences in dance, drama, creative writing, music, and visual art.

The organization stands out for its unique approach, offering a full spectrum of arts activities tailored to diverse needs and abilities. Programs are designed with person-centered care, emphasizing individual autonomy and goal fulfillment. Beyond direct instruction, ARTS for ALL Wisconsin actively supports artists with disabilities by providing platforms to sell and display their work, fostering professional development through initiatives like the annual Creative Power Call for Art. This holistic engagement ensures that the arts serve as a powerful tool for wellness, expression, and community integration throughout the state.

data.Title: Arts Wisconsin
data.Description:
Create Wisconsin, based in Madison, WI, is the state's leading community cultural development organization, dedicated to powering Wisconsin's creative economy. It acts as a vital catalyst, connecting the creative sector—including non-profits and creative businesses—with policymakers and economic leaders. This strategic alignment drives growth, boosts tourism, and enhances community vibrancy across the state, fostering a Wisconsin recognized nationally and globally as a top creative sector state.

The organization champions the arts by advocating for supportive legislative policies and uplifting artists through robust community connections. Create Wisconsin provides crucial resources, linking creatives to jobs, offering support for non-profits and small businesses, and hosting events that foster collaboration. By investing in Wisconsin's creative future, Create Wisconsin supports the economic, educational, and civic health of all residents, ensuring the arts, culture, and creativity remain at the core of the state's identity.

data.Title: AtwoodFest
data.Description:
AtwoodFest is a vibrant community festival held annually in Madison, Wisconsin during the last weekend in July. 

AtwoodFest celebrates local culture with an eclectic mix of live music, art, food, and family-friendly activities. 

AtwoodFest takes place on July 25-26, 2026 and features 30 bands on three stages with music from noon to 10PM on Saturday and noon to 7:30PM on Sunday. 

A diverse lineup of talented artists include local, regional, national and internationally touring acts. 
With its roots deeply embedded in the local community, AtwoodFest not only promotes local businesses and artisans but also fosters a sense of togetherness among residents and visitors alike.

Beyond music, AtwoodFest offers a variety of attractions, including a vendor alley filled with unique handmade goods, delicious eats from local eateries, food trucks, and engaging activities for children at KidsFest. 

AtwoodFest is committed to sustainability and inclusivity, encouraging attendees to bike to the event, but leave your pooch at home.

See the FAQ at www.atwoodfest.com

data.Title: Badger Childhood Cancer Network
data.Description:
The Badger Childhood Cancer Network (BCCN) is a vital organization based in Madison, WI, dedicated to supporting families whose children are battling cancer or life-threatening blood disorders. Serving over 30 counties, BCCN partners with the American Family Children’s Hospital, a UW-Hospital and Clinics affiliate, to provide crucial assistance to approximately 100 newly diagnosed children each year, alongside hundreds more undergoing ongoing treatment or experiencing relapse.

BCCN understands the immense challenges families face, including the significant financial burden, with many experiencing a 40% loss in income during the first year of diagnosis. The network offers critical services designed to alleviate these pressures, enabling parents to focus on their child's care rather than worrying about making ends meet. By providing comprehensive support, BCCN helps families navigate the complexities of childhood cancer, offering peace of mind during an incredibly difficult time.

data.Title: Badger Honor Flight
data.Description:
Badger Honor Flight is a dedicated regional affiliate of the national Honor Flight Network, based in Madison, WI. The organization's core mission is to provide World War II, Korean War, Vietnam War, and terminally ill veterans from any conflict with the profound opportunity to visit the national memorials erected in their honor in Washington D.C. This vital service ensures that these heroes receive the recognition and gratitude they deserve.

Committed to honoring veterans' immense sacrifices, Badger Honor Flight provides an all-inclusive experience at no cost to the veterans. This covers all transportation, meals, and lodging, along with essential items like shirts, jackets, and hats. Volunteer guardians accompany the veterans, ensuring their safety and comfort throughout the trip. While guardians pay a trip fee, the veterans' journey is entirely funded through donations, emphasizing the community's appreciation for their service.

Veterans and guardians interested in participating must submit an application to the Madison, WI hub. Selections are made on a first-come, first-served basis, with special priority given to terminally ill veterans and World War II veterans, reflecting the urgency and historical significance of their service. Badger Honor Flight proudly flies these national heroes to witness the monuments that stand as enduring tributes to their bravery.

data.Title: Badger Rock Neighborhood Center
data.Description:
Badger Rock Neighborhood Center in Madison, WI, serves as a dynamic community resource dedicated to enriching the lives of local residents. It offers a diverse array of programs focused on education, sustainable living, and community building. Through workshops, events, and collaborative projects, the Center empowers individuals of all ages to develop new skills, foster meaningful connections, and contribute to a thriving neighborhood environment.

The Center distinguishes itself by integrating principles of environmental stewardship and healthy lifestyles into its core offerings. From urban gardening initiatives to educational seminars on renewable energy, Badger Rock provides practical, hands-on opportunities for community members to engage with sustainable practices. Its commitment to holistic well-being extends to promoting local food systems and providing accessible spaces for recreation and social interaction.

This comprehensive approach ensures that Badger Rock Neighborhood Center remains a vital cornerstone for community development and resilience in Madison, fostering a stronger, more connected, and environmentally conscious community.

data.Title: Badger Startup Summit
data.Description:
The Badger Startup Summit is a premier entrepreneurial event in Madison, Wisconsin, serving as the official kickoff for the annual Forward Fest. Designed to build and support the next generation of founders, the summit provides an interactive, workshop-driven environment where early-stage entrepreneurs, seasoned operators, and investors connect. It acts as a vital front door to the Wisconsin startup ecosystem, fostering collaboration and innovation.

The summit features diverse programming tailored to various stages of business growth, from foundational idea-stage workshops to advanced sessions on traction, exits, and SBIR funding. Attendees benefit from hands-on learning tracks, candid fireside chats with industry leaders, and exclusive one-on-one mentor and investor sessions that offer direct, actionable feedback. Additionally, the event hosts a live pitch competition where emerging startups showcase their ventures to win cash prizes.

By partnering with key regional organizations like 100state, the UW-Madison Technology Entrepreneurship Office, and the Center for Technology Commercialization, the Badger Startup Summit delivers high-value resources and networking opportunities. It is an essential gathering for anyone looking to launch, scale, or support a business in Wisconsin's vibrant entrepreneurial landscape.

data.Title: Bayview Foundation
data.Description:
Bayview Foundation is a nonprofit organization in Madison, WI, dedicated to providing affordable housing and comprehensive supportive services to low-income, culturally diverse families. The vibrant Bayview neighborhood features 73 apartment units and 57 townhouses, offering stable and secure homes for residents. Central to its mission is a robust community center, integrated within the housing development, which serves as a hub for education, recreation, and community building.

The Foundation's unique model combines stable housing with extensive programming designed to foster cultural pride and individual aspirations. The community center offers a wide array of services, including food access programs, adult and senior skill-building workshops, and youth programming like after-school care and summer camps. Through these initiatives, Bayview Foundation actively works to ensure children succeed in school, boost economic mobility for adults, and enable seniors to age gracefully in place.

Driven by core values of reciprocity, diversity, anti-racism, and creativity, Bayview Foundation is committed to creating an inclusive and equitable environment. A recent redevelopment has enhanced its sustainable housing and community center, incorporating public art and resident input to further strengthen neighborhood ties and lift voices. This holistic approach empowers residents to thrive, making Bayview a gateway to a better life in Madison.

data.Title: Beth Israel Center
data.Description:
Beth Israel Center is a traditional, egalitarian Conservative synagogue located in Madison, Wisconsin. It serves as a vibrant and caring spiritual home dedicated to helping individuals explore and nurture their unique Jewish identities. The center fosters a dynamic kehillah (community) alive with celebration, learning, prayer, and a commitment to tikkun olam (repairing the world), where Conservative Judaism meaningfully connects with contemporary life.

The synagogue's vision encompasses three core pillars: Beit Tefillah (House of Prayer), Beit Knesset (House of Gathering), and Beit Midrash (House of Study). It offers inspiring, participatory rituals, including daily worship, Shabbat, and holiday services, fostering a sense of purpose and holiness. As a welcoming and inclusive Beit Knesset, Beth Israel Center provides diverse social, educational, spiritual, and cultural opportunities for all ages, promoting tzedekah and gemilut hasadim. Its Beit Midrash offers dynamic Jewish learning for youth and adults, deepening connection to Torah, Jewish life, and Eretz Yisrael, cultivating future leadership and lifelong appreciation for Jewish tradition.

data.Title: Bethel Lutheran Church
data.Description:
Bethel Lutheran Church in Madison, WI, is a vibrant and inclusive Evangelical Lutheran Church in America (ELCA) congregation. As a Reconciling in Christ (RIC) church, Bethel is deeply committed to publicly welcoming all individuals, including those of all races, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, abilities, and socioeconomic statuses, reflecting God's unconditional love. Its mission, "Jesus loves you. Walk with Him," guides its efforts to create a safe and peaceful place for all to connect with faith.

Guided by its vision of worship, community, learning, and serving, Bethel offers a wide array of ministries designed for lifelong learning, community building, nurturing connections across generations, and serving others. These include comprehensive programs for adults, youth, kids, and families, alongside dedicated ministries for men, women, and seniors. The church actively engages in service through its Care Ministry, Food Pantry, and Homeless Support Services, embodying its commitment to grace, mercy, and justice in the community and beyond.

Beyond its direct congregational support, Bethel extends its impact through initiatives like Bethel Horizons, an environmental education and retreat center, and the Historic Steensland House Apartments, fostering a service-focused community. Since its founding in 1865, Bethel Lutheran Church has strived to be a place where all feel safe, find peace, and grow in faith.

data.Title: Black Men Coalition of Dane County
data.Description:
Black Men Coalition of Dane County (BMCDC) is a Madison, WI-based non-profit dedicated to fostering a safe and inclusive environment for vulnerable populations. Founded in 2020, initially to uplift Black men and youth and dismantle stereotypes, BMCDC has expanded its mission to proudly support individuals of all races and genders. The organization achieves this through comprehensive programs focused on community involvement, mentorship, education, employment skills, and supported housing.

BMCDC's unique approach is rooted in the lived experiences of its founders—Black men who have overcome systemic barriers. This perspective allows BMCDC to effectively reach and empower those often overlooked by traditional human service systems, breaking down barriers to opportunity and replacing isolation with connection. Their initiatives include supportive housing, job readiness and supported employment, financial literacy classes, transportation services, and professional development scholarships through eCornell.

By providing these vital resources, Black Men Coalition of Dane County generates a sense of belonging, promotes independent living, and cultivates positive outcomes for its community members. They are committed to influencing positive change and enabling individuals to realize their full strength and potential, contributing to a stronger, more inclusive Dane County.

data.Title: Blackhawk Church - Downtown
data.Description:
Blackhawk Church - Downtown is a vibrant, multicultural, and multigenerational Christian community located at Upper House, 365 E. Campus Mall in Madison, WI. As an evangelical church affiliated with the Evangelical Free Church of America, we are united by our mission to build a loving community that follows Christ and reaches those lost without Him. We believe in the transforming power of a relationship with God, welcoming everyone regardless of their background or stage of faith. Our Sunday services feature live worship and a livestreamed message, with dedicated Blackhawk Kids programming for birth through sixth grade.

We are deeply committed to the flourishing of Madison and actively engage with the University of Wisconsin and local colleges, believing that reaching the campus is reaching the world. Our partnership with the Stephen and Laurel Brown Foundation at Upper House allows us to host programs that bring people together around faith, culture, and leadership. Beyond worship, we live out our faith through community service initiatives like 'Cooking For Good,' which prepares meals for those experiencing homelessness at The Beacon, demonstrating our commitment to loving our city and sharing the Good News.

data.Title: Bridge Lake Point Waunona Neighborhood Center
data.Description:
Bridge Lake Point Waunona (BLW) Neighborhood Center is a vibrant community hub in Southeast Madison, WI, dedicated to transforming lives and fostering a unified, resilient community. Since 2004, BLW has supported its residents by addressing their identified needs through a wide array of free and open-to-all programs and services. The center acts as a joyful gathering place, welcoming individuals and families from all walks of life, emphasizing diversity, community ownership, and connection.

BLW Center offers comprehensive support, including a food pantry, community meals, and health and wellness programs. Its robust youth programming encompasses Los Niños Primero for early childhood development, as well as elementary and teen programs providing homework help, tutoring, and enriching activities. Additionally, the Family Resource Center offers bilingual staff to connect families with social services, while the senior program provides fitness, games, and workshops. BLW empowers community members not only by linking them to vital services but also by creating opportunities for them to contribute and strengthen their community.

data.Title: Business Learning Commons
data.Description:
The Business Learning Commons, an integral part of the UW–Madison Libraries located within Grainger Hall in Madison, WI, serves as a vital hub for business students, faculty, and researchers. It provides a comprehensive suite of resources and services designed to support academic and professional success in the business field. Users benefit from extensive access to specialized business databases, facilitating in-depth market research, industry analysis, and company information retrieval.

Beyond digital resources, the Commons offers essential physical amenities including computers, specialized software, and dedicated study rooms that can be reserved for individual or group work. Faculty members can leverage tailored services, including course reserves and instructional support, to enhance their teaching and research endeavors. The Business Learning Commons also provides valuable tutorials and help pages, ensuring users can effectively navigate its vast collection and maximize their learning potential. This dedicated environment fosters a collaborative and resource-rich setting for all business-related academic pursuits.

data.Title: Calvary Gospel Church
data.Description:
Calvary Gospel Church in Madison, WI, serves as a vibrant spiritual home dedicated to fostering faith, community, and personal growth. Rooted in the teachings of the Gospel, the church provides a welcoming environment for individuals and families seeking to deepen their spiritual journey and connect with like-minded believers. Its mission extends beyond weekly services, aiming to inspire members to live out their faith through service and compassion within the wider Madison area.

The church is committed to creating a supportive and engaging atmosphere where everyone feels valued. Through uplifting worship experiences, insightful biblical teachings, and various fellowship opportunities, Calvary Gospel Church strives to equip its congregation with the tools for spiritual development and meaningful relationships. It emphasizes the importance of community involvement and actively encourages its members to contribute positively to the local fabric of Madison.

Calvary Gospel Church stands as a beacon of hope and faith, offering a place for reflection, celebration, and shared purpose. It is a community where individuals can find encouragement, guidance, and a sense of belonging, all while exploring and expressing their faith in a contemporary and relevant way.

data.Title: Canopy Center
data.Description:
Canopy Center is a vital resource dedicated to breaking the cycle of abuse and neglect among children and families in Dane and Columbia County. By offering a comprehensive range of stabilizing services, Canopy Center serves as a safety net for vulnerable youth, ensuring they receive the support they need to thrive. The organization actively engages the community, empowering individuals to become advocates and volunteers, particularly through its CASA program, which trains community members to provide critical advocacy for children in the foster care system.

With a commitment to fostering hope and resilience, Canopy Center's programs are tailored to address the unique challenges faced by children and families affected by trauma. The organization not only provides essential psychoeducation and therapy but also promotes community involvement through fundraising events and volunteer opportunities. By partnering with local businesses and community members, Canopy Center amplifies its impact, making a significant difference in the lives of countless children and families.

data.Title: Capital Entrepreneurs
data.Description:
Capital Entrepreneurs is a grassroots community group dedicated to fostering a vibrant entrepreneurial ecosystem in Madison, Wisconsin. Founded in May 2009 by entrepreneurs for entrepreneurs, the organization serves as the "social fabric" connecting founders and early employees across diverse industries, including technology, biotech, food, and healthcare IT. Its core mission is to unite entrepreneurs, facilitate connections, and support the growth of startups in the Madison area.

Through regular networking events, monthly meetups, and its annual flagship event, Founder Day, Capital Entrepreneurs provides a platform for collaboration, mentorship, and shared learning. Members benefit from a supportive environment where they can overcome challenges, celebrate successes, and navigate the complexities of building a business. The community boasts a track record of success, with member companies participating in top incubators, employing hundreds, raising millions in funding, and achieving significant acquisitions.

Capital Entrepreneurs is committed to building a robust network where every founder can find resources, guidance, and a strong sense of belonging. The organization strictly focuses on supporting founders and early startup employees, ensuring a peer-driven environment dedicated to innovation and growth within Madison's dynamic startup scene.

data.Title: Catholic Multicultural Center
data.Description:
The Catholic Multicultural Center (CMC) in Madison, WI, serves as a vital hub for the city's diverse communities, offering essential support, education, and pathways to stability. Rooted in principles of dignity and belonging, the CMC is dedicated to creating a welcoming and inclusive environment where individuals and families from all cultures can access resources, strengthen their lives, and move towards greater opportunity. The center's purpose is to affirm dignity, foster belonging, and help people build hopeful, self-sustaining futures.

The CMC provides a comprehensive range of services designed to meet essential needs, remove barriers, and facilitate community integration. These offerings include critical assistance with food access, basic resources, and daily necessities. The center also focuses on education and skill-building through programs like English language learning and workforce readiness, alongside employment and economic support initiatives. A key service is immigration legal assistance, guiding individuals through complex systems. By fostering community connection and engagement, the CMC supports immigrants, refugees, and families facing economic hardship or systemic challenges, helping them navigate new environments and build strong, connected lives in Madison.

data.Title: Ceiba Foundation for Tropical Conservation
data.Description:
Ceiba Foundation for Tropical Conservation, based in Madison, WI, is a non-profit organization dedicated to safeguarding threatened ecosystems and incredible biodiversity through community-based conservation. Since its founding in 1997, Ceiba's core mission has been to connect tropical nature with sustainable livelihoods, primarily focusing its efforts on Ecuador's critically endangered coastal dry forests and Andean cloud forests—two of the most threatened ecosystems globally. The organization empowers local communities and landowners to actively participate in conservation, fostering long-term, locally-driven environmental stewardship.

Ceiba's multifaceted strategy encompasses establishing and supporting locally-operated nature reserves, implementing robust biodiversity and habitat protection programs, and delivering vital environmental education. They also conduct scientific research to inform conservation strategies, offer world-class international education programs like study abroad, and work to strengthen local livelihoods and public health. A key differentiator is their commitment to building trust and utilizing innovative legal tools such as conservation easements, which keep land in local hands while ensuring its enduring protection. With over two decades of experience in Ecuador, Ceiba has cultivated strong connections and a proven track record in promoting sustainable conservation.

data.Title: Centro
data.Description:
Mi Centro is a vibrant community hub dedicated to empowering the Hispanic population through a diverse range of services designed to promote cultural enrichment, education, and economic advancement.
