They assist with navigating VA benefits through their Regional Claims Office, preserve veteran stories at the Wisconsin Veterans Museum, and offer critical support for homeless and at-risk veterans via the Veterans Outreach and Recovery Program (VORP) and Veterans Housing and Recovery Program (VHRP). Additionally, WDVA administers state-specific benefits for education, employment, and financial aid.

Guided by a Secretary appointed by the Governor and advised by a citizen Board of Veterans Affairs, WDVA is structured into specialized divisions to deliver targeted support. This includes divisions for Veterans Benefits, Veterans Homes, and Enterprise Services, all working to uphold a legacy of unwavering support for Wisconsin's veteran community.

data.Title: Wisconsin Environment, Inc.
data.Description:
Wisconsin Environment, Inc., based in Madison, WI, is dedicated to protecting the natural world and guiding the country onto a greener, healthier path. As part of a network of 30 state environmental groups, the organization champions clean air, clean water, clean energy, wildlife and open spaces, and a livable climate. Their comprehensive approach involves grassroots support, in-depth research, public education, strategic advocacy, and impactful litigation to address critical environmental challenges like waste, toxics, and global warming. They firmly believe in shifting from a culture of depletion to one of preservation and sustainability.

The organization's campaigns are designed to put the environment front and center, building broad public support for actions that protect the land, air, water, and wildlife essential for all life. This strategic approach has yielded significant results, including growth in solar and wind power, cleaner air, reduced global warming pollution, and cuts in single-use plastics. Wisconsin Environment, Inc. actively unites diverse coalitions of citizens, business owners, farmers, and community leaders, engaging members and activists across the state and working with policymakers to achieve lasting environmental improvements. They are part of The Public Interest Network, committed to a shared vision of a better world.

data.Title: Wisconsin Environmental Inttv
data.Description:

Guided by its motto, "Doing well by doing good," WEI fosters collaboration among policymakers, businesses, and communities to create lasting, systemic change. The organization is dedicated to balancing today’s environmental challenges with tomorrow’s opportunities, driving innovation and overcoming barriers to achieve measurable results for a thriving, sustainable Wisconsin.

WEI develops innovative policies and tools that empower Wisconsin businesses and communities to achieve credible market distinction while preserving the state’s natural resources. Through its key programs—Green Built Home, Main Street Green, Clean Clear Waters, and Wisconsin Green Growth—WEI delivers visionary yet practical solutions. These initiatives help homeowners, businesses, and municipalities sustain and enhance Wisconsin’s legacy of environmental leadership, reflecting a commitment to long-term impact for future generations.

data.Title: Card Trade
data.Description:
Based in Milwaukee, WI, Card Trade is a specialized transaction security platform designed to protect collectors buying and selling trading cards online. Operating across popular social channels like Facebook, Instagram, and Discord, the service acts as a secure intermediary to eliminate scams and fraudulent transactions. By verifying user identities and securing payments until delivery is confirmed, Card Trade provides peace of mind for high-value transactions involving sports cards, gaming cards, and rare collectibles.

Unlike traditional online marketplaces that charge steep transaction fees, Card Trade offers a streamlined alternative with zero marketplace fees, allowing collectors to keep more of their profits. The platform features robust scam protection coverage for deals up to $5,000, making it a trusted solution for securing high-value "grail" card transactions. With a user-friendly mobile application available on both iOS and Android, collectors can easily create and secure a transaction in under a minute, ensuring safe payouts for sellers and protected payments for buyers.

data.Title: CardScout
data.Description:
Based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, CardScout is an innovative digital platform designed for sports card collectors, dealers, and hobbyists looking to secure the best deals on the market. By continuously monitoring a vast and growing network of Facebook buy, sell, and trade groups, the service acts as an automated scout that scans millions of listings around the clock. Users can easily search for any specific card, player, set, slab, parallel, or autograph, and save their searches to receive instant notifications the moment a matching item is posted.

This powerful tool eliminates the need for collectors to manually scroll through dozens of social media groups, saving valuable time and ensuring they never miss a rare find. By delivering rapid alerts and direct-to-buy links, CardScout gives buyers a competitive edge, allowing them to connect with sellers and secure highly coveted cards seconds after they are listed. Whether you are a casual collector or a high-volume dealer, the platform provides the speed and coverage needed to navigate the fast-paced hobby market.

data.Title: codeguardian,inc
data.Description:
Based in Milwaukee, WI, CodeGuardian, Inc. is an innovative AEC compliance platform designed to bridge the gap between architectural designers and municipal plan reviewers. By integrating directly into Revit, the software allows design teams to scan their models for code compliance, egress, fire/life safety, and accessibility risks early in the design phase. This proactive approach helps identify critical issues before they lead to expensive redesigns or lengthy permit delays.

CodeGuardian, Inc. offers a robust suite of tools including typology presets, permit review gates, and click-to-locate navigation to streamline workflows for architects, BIM managers, and VDC leads. By moving compliance checks earlier in the design process, the platform reduces back-and-forth friction with city reviewers and ensures smoother project delivery.

Looking forward, CodeGuardian, Inc. is expanding its platform to support cloud-based municipal plan reviews. This expansion aims to help cities process submitted drawings faster, reduce permit backlogs, and improve feedback consistency, ultimately creating a more efficient compliance ecosystem for both designers and local governments.

data.Title: Gesund Health
data.Description:
Gesund Health, based in Milwaukee, WI, is pioneering the future of medical data interpretation with its advanced AI platform. This innovative solution transforms fragmented health data—from claims and EHR to labs and notes—into a unified, interpretable, and clinically validated narrative. By employing MultiExpert™ AI agents, Gesund provides a true clinical reasoning engine that deeply understands patient context, risk, and medical timelines, moving beyond traditional rules-based systems.

The platform delivers unparalleled clinical intelligence for both healthcare systems and life insurance providers. For healthcare, it enables precision care through true risk stratification, clinical episode grouping, quality measure automation, and predictive analytics, offering rich patient summaries. For life insurance, Gesund facilitates precision underwriting by providing full medical interpretation in seconds, delivering accurate condition severity, treatment pathway analysis, and explainable risk summaries with reinsurer-grade accuracy, significantly reducing APS costs and accelerating turnarounds. Built on over a decade of expertise, Gesund Health is dedicated to ensuring every decision is informed by the full medical truth, fostering a future of clinically intelligent healthcare and underwriting.

data.Title: Ready Rebound
data.Description:
Ready Rebound, based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, specializes in delivering expedited, high-quality healthcare advocacy and recovery solutions for essential workers. Recognizing that those who keep communities safe and running deserve the best, Ready Rebound provides a "VIP Expedited Care" model, similar to that offered to professional athletes, ensuring faster access to care, coordinated recovery services, and clear communication throughout the healing process. They partner with public safety departments and essential worker organizations to mitigate the impact of injuries on rosters and budgets.

The company's leadership team comprises former fire and police chiefs, officers, firefighters, educators, and sports medicine-trained therapists, bringing over 300 years of combined experience. This unique expertise allows Ready Rebound to deeply understand the challenges essential workers face and the critical need for efficient recovery. Services include expert triage, immediate access to diagnosis, and hands-on care navigation, covering both on- and off-duty injuries for employees, their immediate families, department staff, and retirees.

By partnering with Ready Rebound, organizations achieve significant benefits, including decreased time to recovery, faster case closures, and substantial savings in workers' compensation and overtime costs. Their mission is to get essential workers back to their jobs, families, and lives as quickly and healthily as possible, ultimately protecting those who protect us by ensuring a robust and healthy workforce.

data.Title: Brett Newski & The Bad Inventions
data.Description:
Brett Newski & The Bad Inventions, based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, is a distinctive musical entity known for its unique blend of "Folk-Grunge, Alt-country, and Garage Americana." This acclaimed artist masterfully combines the freewheeling lyricism reminiscent of 60s Bob Dylan with the raw, melodic bite of 90s alternative rock, often evoking the production style of a lost Velvet Underground tape. Their latest album, *Have a Thing, Miss Your Moment, Wait for the Revival*, recorded straight to cassette, exemplifies their commitment to analog charm and a contrarian ethos, notably opting out of major streaming platforms and Amazon for its release.

Beyond music, Brett Newski is also an accomplished author, illustrator, and podcaster. His books, including *It's Hard to be a Person: defeating anxiety, surviving the world, and having more fun* and *Piss in the Wind: Misadventures of an Indie Troubadour Vol. 1*, showcase his unique blend of humor, mental health advocacy, and candid storytelling from extensive global tours. Having shared stages with acts like Violent Femmes and Pixies, and garnered praise from Rolling Stone and NPR, Brett Newski & The Bad Inventions offers a rich, multifaceted artistic experience rooted in authentic rock 'n' roll and insightful narrative.

data.Title: Greater Milwaukee Chamber of Commerce, Inc.

Members can choose from virtually instructed 30-minute isometric sessions like Hot Yoga, Hot Pilates, Hot Core, and Hot Warrior, or opt for intense 15-minute High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT) sessions such as Hot Cycle, Hot Thunder, and Hot Blast. This innovative approach provides numerous benefits, including increased calorie burn, pain relief, stress reduction, weight loss, improved circulation, and anti-aging effects. Beyond the infrared saunas, HOTWORX - Sun Prairie, WI also features an FX Zone equipped with bands, weights, and ropes for functional training, allowing members to complement their sauna workouts. With 24/7 access to over 800 studios worldwide, HOTWORX empowers individuals with busy lifestyles to achieve their fitness goals consistently and efficiently. The studio is dedicated to helping the Sun Prairie community embrace a healthier lifestyle through its cutting-edge fitness program.

data.Title: Joel Roberts
data.Description:
Joel Roberts is the visionary behind the innovative AI Lab in Waukesha, WI, a pioneering space dedicated to democratizing game development. His initiative empowers individuals, regardless of their coding experience, to transform creative ideas into playable games within just 30 minutes. The AI Lab stands out by leveraging artificial intelligence to build games based solely on user descriptions, making game creation accessible and engaging for everyone.

This unique platform, spearheaded by Roberts, simplifies the development process into three intuitive steps: users describe their game concept, the AI constructs it, and then it's tested and shipped to an arcade. The lab adheres to a set of creative constraints, ensuring games are single-screen, feature shapes, colors, and emojis as sprites, and always include a score, a way to lose, and a restart option. These rules encourage focused creativity and rapid prototyping.

Under Joel Roberts' guidance, the AI Lab fosters a vibrant community of creators, turning abstract concepts into tangible digital experiences. It's more than just a game-building tool; it's a hub for innovation and a testament to the power of AI in unlocking creative potential, building a diverse arcade of games crafted by its visitors.

data.Title: Blue Soul Yoga & Wellness Center
data.Description:
Blue Soul Yoga & Wellness Center, located in Waunakee, WI, provides a nurturing environment for individuals to explore and deepen their yoga practice. Founded in 2015 by Katy Blum, an ERYT500 certified instructor, the center is built upon a philosophy of cultivating self-awareness, strength, and inner peace. Katy's extensive background includes certifications in Power Yoga, Ashtanga, Senior Yoga, Yin and Restorative Yoga, Sound Healing, Chakra Balancing, and Reiki, offering a diverse and holistic approach to wellness.

The center offers a comprehensive range of services designed to meet varied needs, including both in-person studio and convenient Zoom yoga classes. Students can benefit from private and corporate yoga sessions, specialized chair yoga, and transformative Reiki sessions. Katy's teaching style is characterized by its joyful and peaceful nature, encouraging students to focus on breath and introspection, fostering a meditative experience in motion.

Beyond regular classes, Blue Soul Yoga & Wellness Center is also home to The Blue Soul School of Yoga, established in 2017. This school offers a renowned 200-Hour Yoga Teacher Training program, guiding aspiring instructors on a journey of self-discovery and transformation. The center further enriches the community with various workshops and retreats, providing opportunities for deeper engagement and growth in yoga and wellness practices.

data.Title: Red Barn Company Store
data.Description:
Red Barn Company Store in Waunakee, WI, offers a distinctive collection of gifts, home decor, and specialty items, catering to both local residents and visitors. The store is renowned for its extensive selection of lake-themed art and decor, featuring customizable barrel end style lake wall art and bathymetry pieces for numerous lakes across the United States, with a particular focus on Wisconsin's beloved waterways. This unique offering allows customers to celebrate their favorite lakes with personalized, handcrafted items.

Beyond its signature lake art, Red Barn Company Store curates a diverse inventory including popular brands like PANDORA jewelry, comfortable Lakegirl apparel, and high-quality Fusion Mineral Paint for DIY enthusiasts. Shoppers can also explore a charming array of Old World Christmas ornaments, elegant home decor, entertaining and serving ware, and a variety of candles and wax melts. Whether seeking a special gift, a unique piece for the home, or supplies for a creative project, Red Barn Company Store provides a thoughtfully selected range of products designed to inspire and delight.

data.Title: Waunakee Coworks
data.Description:
Waunakee Coworks offers newly remodeled and furnished professional office spaces and shared coworking environments in the heart of Waunakee, WI. Designed to foster productivity and collaboration, the facility provides flexible solutions for individuals and small teams seeking a dynamic workspace. Members benefit from a comprehensive suite of amenities, ensuring a seamless and efficient work experience without the overhead of traditional office management.

The spaces are thoughtfully equipped with high-speed 1 gig fiber internet, height-adjustable desks, executive chairs, and lockable cabinets. Waunakee Coworks prioritizes convenience with utilities, cleaning services, and a fully furnished kitchen including coffee and tea. Additional perks include a comfortable living room, ADA accessibility, company exposure on Main Street, and secure mail and package handling. With month-to-month terms, professionals can choose between dedicated private offices, complete with secure file storage and a personalized suite number, or flexible shared office options suitable for multiple users.

This modern coworking space is ideal for those looking to separate work from home life, connect with other local professionals, or host client meetings in a professional setting. Waunakee Coworks provides an environment that supports focused work, networking opportunities, and a professional presence for businesses in the Waunakee community.

data.Title: American Legion Post 481
data.Description:
American Legion Post 481 in Waunakee, WI, stands as a dedicated local chapter of the nation’s largest veterans service organization. Since its inception, The American Legion has been a steadfast advocate for veterans, active-duty personnel, and military families, a mission proudly upheld by Post 481. This post serves as a vital community hub, committed to upholding the values of service, camaraderie, and patriotism within the Waunakee area.

Post 481 offers a welcoming environment where members can access a range of services and resources designed to support their unique needs. Beyond direct assistance, the post actively works to strengthen the community through various initiatives, including youth mentorship programs and local civic engagement. It fosters a strong sense of belonging among veterans, providing a space for shared experiences and mutual support, while also contributing to the broader effort to combat veteran suicide and ensure the well-being of all who have served.

By joining American Legion Post 481, individuals become part of a powerful network dedicated to making a tangible difference in the lives of those who have sacrificed for our nation. The post’s expertise lies in its deep understanding of veteran affairs and its unwavering commitment to advocating for their rights and benefits, ensuring that the legacy of service is honored and supported in Waunakee and beyond.

data.Title: Windsor Athletic Club
data.Description:
Windsor Athletic Club is Dane County's newest and most comprehensive recreational fitness club, proudly serving Windsor, WI. This locally owned facility offers an unparalleled array of amenities designed to keep individuals and families active and fit year-round. Members enjoy 24/7 access to a state-of-the-art fitness gym equipped with the latest workout machinery, complemented by expert personal training specialists and a diverse schedule of group fitness classes, including Les Mills, Zumba, Yoga, and HIIT.

Beyond traditional gym offerings, Windsor Athletic Club boasts extensive indoor sports facilities. These include a 5-lane swimming pool, multiple indoor basketball, volleyball, and pickleball courts, an indoor soccer field, and golf simulators. The club also features the area's largest indoor track, locker rooms with saunas, and an onsite cafe. For families, convenient onsite childcare is available, ensuring parents can focus on their workouts.

With competitive pricing across various membership tiers—Bronze, Gold, Senior, and Student—Windsor Athletic Club provides flexible options to suit every need. Whether you're seeking a robust workout, engaging group activities, or a place for the whole family to stay active, this club delivers a premium experience with a focus on health and community.

data.Title: Sundara Inn & Spa
data.Description:
Sundara Inn & Spa, nestled in Wisconsin Dells, WI, offers an award-winning oasis of tranquility, natural beauty, and holistic wellness in the heartland. Recognized as the Best Spa for Hydrotherapy by Women's Health Travel Awards 2023, a #2 Best Spa Resort by USA Today 10 Best Readers’ Choice 2023, and a top resort in the Midwest by Travel + Leisure, Sundara has been dedicated to a mission of profound wellness since its opening in 2003.

Guests can immerse themselves in a serene environment, enjoying a range of rejuvenating spa treatments and hydrotherapy designed to refresh mind, body, and soul. The destination spa cherishes its 80-acre pine forest, upholding eco-friendly practices to tread lightly on the earth. Beyond exceptional services, Sundara extends its wellness philosophy through signature products, crafted with indigenous ingredients, allowing guests to bring the rejuvenating experience home. Sundara Inn & Spa provides a distinguished retreat for relaxation and renewal.

Events.Description: An event hosted at a listing (venue). Dates are stored as ISO strings; whether an event is upcoming is derived from the site's Today.

schema.name: EventDate
schema.Description: Calendar date of the event (YYYY-MM-DD). Compared to the site's Today to decide if it is upcoming.

schema.name: EndsAt
schema.Description: Local end timestamp; null if unknown.

schema.name: DoorTime
schema.Description: Free-text door/show line (Doors: 6:30 pm | Show: 8:00 pm).

schema.name: ImageUrl
schema.Description: Poster image URL; empty if none.

schema.name: VenueEntityPath
schema.Description: Link back to the venue page.

schema.name: IsUpcoming
schema.Description: On or after the site's Today.

schema.name: WhenLabel
schema.Description: The doors/show line, or a fallback when none is known.

data.Title: Rodrigo Y Gabriela
data.Description: Comprising Rodrigo Sánchez and Gabriela Quintero, the Mexican acoustic guitar duo Rodrigo y Gabriela is recognized for blending heavy metal, flamenco, and rock influences into an instrumental format. Over a career spanning more than two decades, the duo has established an international reputation for their technical virtuosity and rhythmic complexity. This performance showcases their signature approach of translating high-energy rock and metal dynamics to acoustic instrumentation.
data.Genres: Alternativo & Rock Latino, Nuevo Flamenco, Flamenco / Spanish Flamenco

data.Title: ROOTS REGGAE/ROCKSTEADY GROOVE with MAJOR TOM
data.Description: As part of the weekly Global Grooves series presented by Fernet-Branca, DJ Major Tom will host an evening dedicated to roots reggae and rocksteady. The Thursday night event showcases specialized international music genres curated by prominent Madison-based DJs.

data.Title: Rosebud Baker
data.Description: Rosebud Baker is a comedian, actor, and writer currently serving as a staff writer for NBC’s *Saturday Night Live*. Recognized for her dark, deadpan comedic style, she was previously named a "New Face" at the Just For Laughs Comedy Festival in Montreal. Her debut stand-up special, *Whiskey Fists*, was released by Comedy Central Digital.

data.Title: Sam Morril
data.Description: New York-based stand-up comedian Sam Morril is known for his frequent late-night television appearances and his popular podcast, *We Might Be Drunk*, which he co-hosts with Mark Normand. Morril's career includes five stand-up specials—most recently 2024's *You've Changed* on Amazon Prime—and headlining performances at major venues like The Theater at Madison Square Garden.

data.Title: Schaffer the Darklord, Coolzey
data.Description: New York City-based rapper and comedian Schaffer the Darklord headlines this 21-and-over showcase, bringing his signature blend of high-energy, satirical hip-hop and extensive catalog of thirteen albums to the stage. He is joined by alternative hip-hop artist Coolzey, whose genre-blending style fuses golden-era rap roots with 90s indie rock influences. The event offers a distinct look into the contemporary nerdcore and underground rap scenes, featuring two veteran performers known for their comedic and highly conceptual songwriting.

data.Title: Sensation: A Kinky Naughty Costume Dance Party
data.Description: Crucible’s monthly event, Sensation, returns this Thursday with a costume-focused edition combining electronic music and dedicated play spaces. The night features DJ sets from DJ Bandit and DJ Samogon, supported by live go-go dancers and on-site safety monitors. The 21+ event begins at 8:00 PM with a $10 entry fee.

data.Title: Showtime Social (Jersey Boys)
data.Description: The Showtime Social is a pre-show reception held in the Promenade Lobby 90 minutes prior to performances of the musical "Jersey Boys." The ticketed event offers attendees private access to a selection of appetizers, desserts, and themed beverages, alongside dedicated photo opportunities. Please note that admission to this reception is sold separately and does not include a ticket to the performance itself.
data.Genres: Traditional Pop Music, Pop/Rock, Adult Contemporary

data.Title: SIX
data.Description: *SIX* is a modern musical that reimagines the lives of the six wives of Henry VIII as a pop concert, exploring historical narratives through a contemporary lens. The production features a critically acclaimed score, with its Broadway cast album debuting at number one on the Billboard cast album charts and surpassing one billion global streams. This touring production brings the Tony Award-winning global phenomenon to local audiences.

data.Title: Six-Thirty Sharp
data.Description: Six-Thirty Sharp is a live music event featuring a repertoire of horn rock, R&B, soul, and funk spanning from the 1960s to the present day. Held at [Venue Name], this 21-and-over performance begins at 7:00 PM, with doors opening at 6:00 PM and admission priced at $10.

data.Title: Ska-lloween
data.Description: High Noon Saloon will host its annual Ska-lloween event, a seasonal showcase featuring live performances from local and regional ska bands. The evening combines live music with a themed costume contest, serving as a recurring celebration for the area's ska community.
data.Keywords: Concerts, Intimate venue performances, Live Band Club

data.Title: Sophie Hunter
data.Description: Acclaimed British theatre and opera director Sophie Hunter is recognized for her innovative, avant-garde staging of classical and contemporary musical works. Her portfolio includes highly regarded productions of works by Benjamin Britten and Beethoven, characterized by their minimalist design and integration of visual art. This event showcases her distinct directorial vision and ongoing contributions to contemporary music-theatre.
data.Keywords: Opera performances, Theater productions, Multimedia performances

data.Title: Space 7 Presents: Resonant Frequency 2026
data.Description: Crucible in Madison will host Space 7 Presents: Resonant Frequency 2026 on November 6, featuring a collaborative three-and-a-half-hour electronic music performance. Live hardware artists Pressboard, Matron of Squirrels, Taimbot, and Zinda Laash will perform a linked set, mixed in real-time by DJ Sloth Brigade. The evening is supported by opening and closing DJ sets from Mr. C and live projections by Road Flare Visuals.
data.Keywords: Concerts, Multimedia performances, Intimate venue performances

data.Title: Spooky New World
data.Description: Spooky New World is a curated music showcase focusing on the intersection of darkwave, synth-pop, and experimental electronic music. The event features live performances and audiovisual installations from emerging independent artists within these genres. Designed as a platform for subgenre discovery, the showcase highlights current trends in underground electronic music production.

data.Title: sunn O)))
data.Description: Celebrating twenty-five years of performance, the experimental drone metal group Sunn O))) is touring under their Shoshin (初心) Duo lineup. Founded by Stephen O’Malley and Greg Anderson, the project is recognized for blending metal, drone, and minimalist composition. This tour presents the co-founders in a stripped-back, high-volume duo format that highlights the foundational elements of their work.

data.Title: Tank and The Bangas
data.Description: Led by vocalist Tarriona "Tank" Ball, the New Orleans-based group Tank and The Bangas gained national recognition after winning NPR’s Tiny Desk Contest in 2017. The ensemble's sound blends elements of soul, hip-hop, R&B, jazz, and spoken word. Their live performances are characterized by theatricality and dynamic musical arrangements.

data.Title: Taste of Hope
data.Description: On November 5, 2026, the American Cancer Society will host its Taste of Hope benefit at The Sylvee in Madison, Wisconsin. Emceed by chef and television host Luke Zahm, the culinary event features tastings from prominent local chefs, a curated bar experience, and a silent auction. Proceeds from the evening will fund cancer research and patient support services across the state.
data.Keywords: Food and Beverage Events, Food festivals

data.Title: Thao
data.Description: Oakland-based singer-songwriter and producer Thao Nguyen performs live, showcasing material from her solo career and her tenure fronting the indie rock outfit Thao & The Get Down Stay Down. Known for critically acclaimed albums like *Temple* (2020) and *A Man Alive* (2016), Nguyen has established a prominent career marked by collaborations with artists such as Andrew Bird and Joanna Newsom. This performance highlights her distinct songwriting and multi-instrumental production style.

data.Title: The Bill Roberts Combo
data.Description: Led by award-winning guitarist Bill Roberts, the Madison-based Bill Roberts Combo performs a blend of blues and jazz featuring a rotating lineup of veteran instrumentalists and vocalists. The ensemble, which performs every second Friday at 5:30 PM, is comprised of seasoned musicians with extensive national and international touring experience. This recurring early-evening performance is free and open to the public.
data.Keywords: Jazz nights, Intimate venue performances, Concerts

data.Title: The Bill Roberts Combo
data.Description: Formed in 2014, the Bill Roberts Combo is a Madison-based blues-jazz ensemble led by award-winning guitarist Bill Roberts, whose album *Blues Rides Shotgun* received critical acclaim as best blues album of the year. The group features a lineup of veteran instrumentalists with extensive international touring experience across Europe and North America. Performing as both an instrumental unit and a full band with vocalists, the combo regularly headlines prominent venues throughout Madison and the upper Midwest.

data.Title: The Capitol Social Presents: La Rumba
data.Description: The Cardinal Bar and The Capitol Social are hosting "La Rumba," marking the return of Latin dance programming to the historic Madison venue under its new ownership. The 21-and-over event begins with two hours of simultaneous beginner and intermediate Bachata and Salsa lessons led by The Capitol Social, followed by a four-hour social dance featuring Salsa, Bachata, Cumbia, and Merengue sets by DJ Luis. Admission is $10 at the door, with event photography provided by @armacanqui.photo.
data.Keywords: Dance Party, Latin Music Club, Salsa Club

data.Title: The Capitol Social Presents: La Rumba
data.Description: The Cardinal Bar and The Capitol Social are hosting "La Rumba," marking the return of Latin dance programming to Madison's longest-running Latin music venue. The 21-and-over event begins with two hours of simultaneous beginner and intermediate lessons in bachata and salsa, led by instructors from The Capitol Social. Following the instruction, DJ Luis will spin a selection of classic and contemporary salsa, bachata, cumbia, and merengue from 10:00 p.m. to 2:00 a.m.
data.Keywords: Latin Music Club, Salsa Club, Dance Party

data.Title: The First Lady of Television
data.Description: *The First Lady of Television* is a new biographical play detailing the life of Gertrude Berg, the pioneering writer, producer, and star of America’s first family sitcom, *The Goldbergs*. The drama examines a critical juncture in Berg's career during the 1950s Red Scare, when she was pressured by sponsors and censors to dismiss a blacklisted co-star. The production explores the historical intersection of artistic integrity, political censorship, and the early American television industry.

data.Title: THE MELTING POT with CHUCK MONEY
data.Description: Veteran Madison selector DJ Chuck Money hosts "The Melting Pot," a weekly Friday evening residency featuring a curated mix of soul, jazz, funk, reggae, and Latin rhythms. Sponsored by Ford’s Gin, the event runs from 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM and highlights the DJ's extensive catalog of rare groove and Northern soul. Attendees can also access promotional pricing on select Ford's Gin cocktails during the early hours of the event.

data.Title: THE MELTING POT with CHUCK MONEY
data.Description: Presented by Ford's Gin, "The Melting Pot" is a weekly Friday residency featuring veteran Madison selector DJ Chuck Money. From 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM, the event showcases a curated, genre-spanning mix of soul, jazz, funk, reggae, and Latin rhythms. A promotional discount on Ford's Gin cocktails is available from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM.

data.Title: THE MELTING POT with CHUCK MONEY
data.Description: "The Melting Pot" is a weekly Friday residency featuring veteran Madison selector DJ Chuck Money, running from 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM. Sponsored by Ford's Gin, the event features a curated soundtrack of soul, jazz, funk, reggae, and Latin rhythms. A promotional happy hour on select gin cocktails is offered from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM.

data.Title: The Outsiders
data.Description: Winner of four 2024 Tony Awards, including Best Musical, *The Outsiders* is a stage adaptation of S.E. Hinton’s 1967 novel and Francis Ford Coppola’s subsequent film. The production features a book by Adam Rapp and Justin Levine, with an original score by folk-rock duo Jamestown Revival and Levine, directed by Tony Award-winner Danya Taymor. Set in Tulsa, Oklahoma, the narrative chronicles the socio-economic conflict between the working-class Greasers and their affluent rivals, the Socs.

data.Title: The Remix DJ Battle: Get Out The Vote Rally
data.Description: On Thursday, October 29, 2026, the Urban League of Greater Madison Young Professionals will host "The Remix DJ Battle: Get Out The Vote Rally" at the High Noon Saloon. This non-partisan, 18-and-older event integrates a live DJ competition with civic engagement initiatives designed to encourage voter turnout and community participation in the Madison area.

data.Title: The Rocky Horror Picture Show w/ Madison's Velvet Darkness
data.Description: Crucible will host a seasonal screening of the cult classic *The Rocky Horror Picture Show*, featuring a live performance by Madison-based shadow cast Velvet Darkness. The event offers a traditional interactive cinema experience, combining the film with synchronized live theatrical accompaniment.

data.Title: The Tallest Man On Earth
data.Description: Swedish indie-folk singer-songwriter Kristian Matsson, performing under the moniker The Tallest Man on Earth, will appear at the Majestic Theatre. The performance will showcase Matsson's signature fingerstyle guitar technique and distinct vocals, featuring a repertoire that spans his multi-album discography alongside his latest material.
data.Genres: Indie Folk, Folk Music, Contemporary Folk

data.Title: The Widdler
data.Description: Austin-based producer Yoni Rond, performing as The Widdler, is a foundational figure in the dubstep and sound system culture movements. His signature sound integrates reggae, dub, and dancehall influences with heavy sub-bass and dark, energetic arrangements. This performance highlights his distinct live approach, which relies heavily on a deep catalog of exclusive, unreleased dubplates.

data.Title: The Wooten Brothers
data.Description: The Wooten Brothers—consisting of Regi, Roy, Joseph, and Victor Wooten—bring over forty years of collaborative performance experience to this event. The ensemble is widely recognized for its technical virtuosity and its fusion of jazz, funk, soul, and R&B. This performance highlights the group's collective contributions to contemporary instrumental music and live improvisation.

data.Title: Tommy Brennan
data.Description: New York-based stand-up comedian Tommy Brennan, a newly joined cast member for the 51st season of *Saturday Night Live*, is currently touring nationwide. Named one of Just For Laughs' New Faces of 2023, Brennan is a regular at The Comedy Cellar and has been featured on Comedy Central and Don’t Tell Comedy. He is also the co-creator of the web series *Roommates-In-Law*, which has amassed millions of views online.

data.Title: TRIVIUM
data.Description: Formed in Orlando in 1999, the metal band Trivium is scheduled to perform at The Sylvee. Led by frontman Matt Heafy, the group is recognized for blending metalcore, thrash, and progressive metal across a discography that includes key releases such as *Ascendancy* and *In the Court of the Dragon*.

data.Title: Usama Siddiquee
data.Description: Usama Siddiquee is a Bengali-American comedian, writer, and actor who made his late-night debut on *The Late Show with Stephen Colbert* in 2024 and released his first half-hour special with Don't Tell Comedy in 2025. His credits also include acting roles in Netflix's *Inventing Anna* and *Survival of the Thickest*, and a finalist appearance on Kevin Hart's *Funny AF*.

data.Title: Varsity Mac + Scorched Waves
data.Description: Madison’s High Noon Saloon hosts a co-headlining performance featuring Wisconsin-based indie rock bands Varsity Mac and Scorched Waves. Both groups are active contributors to the regional alternative music scene, known for their guitar-driven songwriting and distinct live performances. The event highlights the current landscape of independent rock within the state's capital.

data.Title: Video Rewind: 80s, 90s, 00s - Retro Costume Dance Party w/ DJ Nick Nice!
data.Description: DJ Nick Nice returns to Crucible for "Video Rewind," marking one of only two seasonal appearances by the artist at the venue. The event features a multi-decade dance set focusing on music from the 1980s, 1990s, and 2000s. In alignment with the retrospective theme, the evening includes a retro-themed costume format.

data.Title: Vidura Bandara Rajapaksa: The Paradise Gothic Tour
data.Description: Sri Lankan comedian, writer, and director Vidura Bandara Rajapaksa presents "The Paradise Gothic Tour." His self-directed and self-written comedy specials include "Monsoon Season" (2022), "French Kiss Tunnel" (2024), and "Woodapple Jam" (2024).

data.Title: VINYL LISTENING PARTY: JALEN NGONDA - “DOCTRINE OF LOVE”
data.Description: Inspired by the Japanese "Jazz Kissa" concept, this vinyl listening event features a full-album playback of Jalen Ngonda’s *Doctrine of Love* on a high-fidelity sound system in an acoustically treated room. Organized in collaboration with Strictly Discs and Dancing Goat Distillery, the featured record will be played from start to finish beginning at 8:30 PM.

data.Title: VINYL LISTENING PARTY: JUNGLE - “SUNSHINE”
data.Description: Inspired by the Japanese "Jazz Kissa" concept, this listening session features a full-album playback of Jungle's *Sunshine* utilizing a high-fidelity sound system in an acoustically treated room. Curated in collaboration with Strictly Discs and Dancing Goat Distillery, the event presents the record in its entirety with playback beginning at 8:30 PM.

data.Title: VINYL LISTENING PARTY: NIGHTMARE BEOFRE CHRISTMAS - “THE ALBUM”
data.Description: Inspired by the Japanese "Jazz Kissa" tradition, this listening event features a full-album playback of *The Nightmare Before Christmas* soundtrack on a high-fidelity sound system in an acoustically treated room. Curated by Lola's in collaboration with Strictly Discs and Dancing Goat Distillery, the dedicated audio session begins at 8:30 PM.

data.Title: VINYL LISTENING PARTY: THE SMITHS - “THE QUEEN IS DEAD”
data.Description: This listening event, inspired by the Japanese "Jazz Kissa" high-fidelity bar concept, features a full playback of The Smiths' 1986 album *The Queen is Dead*. Hosted in an acoustically treated room with a specialized HiFi sound system, the session is presented in collaboration with independent record store Strictly Discs and Dancing Goat Distillery. The album playback begins promptly at 8:30 PM.
data.Genres: Indie Rock, Alternative Rock, College Rock

data.Title: Viva Saturday with DJ Chamo
data.Description: "Viva Saturday" is a weekly Latin music event hosted at [Venue Name] featuring DJ Chamo, who spins a diverse selection of genres including salsa, merengue, bachata, cumbia, reggaeton, and dembow. The 21-and-over event begins at 10:00 PM and requires a $10 cover charge at the door.
data.Keywords: Latin Music Club, Dance Party, Dance Club

data.Title: Vivian Lark Presents: Cabaret Noir
data.Description: Hosted at Crucible, *Vivian Lark Presents: Cabaret Noir* is a 90-minute showcase featuring professional Madison-area vocalists, drag artists, and classical burlesque performers. Accompanied by live music, the production explores the cynical and decadent themes of film noir. This seasonal iteration incorporates a distinct focus on dark and macabre aesthetics.

data.Title: Walk Off // Rad Skulls // Geoff Palmer // Los Kausas ** MATINEE SHOW **
data.Description: This 18+ matinee showcase highlights the regional punk scene, featuring Madison-based melodic punk band Walk Off alongside veteran melodic punk outfit Rad Skulls. The lineup also includes Stardumb Records power-pop singer-songwriter Geoff Palmer and local hardcore act Los Kausas. Doors open at 1:00 PM with the performance starting at 2:00 PM.

data.Title: Weird World of Frogs
data.Description: As part of the National Geographic Live series, conservation biologist and National Geographic Explorer Dr. Jodi Rowley will present an in-depth look at amphibian biodiversity and conservation. The event features an immersive stage presentation, pre-show trivia, and an interactive Q&A session highlighting Rowley’s extensive field research, which includes co-discovering 40 new frog species and leading the national FrogID citizen science project. Rowley, the curator of amphibian and reptile conservation biology at the Australian Museum, will share behind-the-scenes insights from her dozens of expeditions across Australasia.

data.Title: West 22nd
data.Description: Austin, Texas-based indie-rock band West 22nd is scheduled to perform, showcasing a sound influenced by classic indie rock and modern alternative genres. Formed in 2022, the group has quickly established a regional presence through their melodic, guitar-driven songwriting.

data.Title: Wheelhouse and Lucas Cates Band 12th Annual Ugly Sweater Party
data.Description: High Noon Saloon will host the 12th Annual Ugly Sweater Party, marking over a decade of this seasonal live music tradition. The event features performances by prominent regional acts Wheelhouse and the Lucas Cates Band.

data.Title: Winyah
data.Description: The indie folk-rock project Winyah is characterized by its integration of atmospheric soundscapes, narrative songwriting, and Americana influences. This performance showcases the project's distinct, genre-blending approach to contemporary live music.
data.Genres: Indie Folk, Contemporary Folk, Folk Music

data.Title: Wisconsin Book Festival Lectures
data.Description: As part of the 25th annual Wisconsin Book Festival, the Madison Museum of Contemporary Art (MMoCA) will host a series of free literary lectures and author presentations from October 16 to 18, 2026. The three-day program features discussions with prominent writers and scholars, including Téa Obreht, Barbara McQuade, and Monona Wali, covering topics ranging from political corruption to contemporary fiction. The event provides a platform for public engagement with diverse literary works in MMoCA's Lecture Hall.
data.Keywords: Book Festivals, Book Readings, Community Events

data.Title: Words with Nerds: Wisconsin Science Festival Edition
data.Description: As part of the Wisconsin Science Festival, the infotainment series "Words with Nerds" will host a special edition on October 15 at Crucible in Madison. Hosted by Sasha Rosser, the event features a hybrid format of academic presentation and stand-up comedy, with scheduled speakers including Anupreksha Jain, Sarah Adelman, and Dr. Sepehr Vakil. Topics for the evening will span entomology and Iranian geopolitics, showcasing the series' signature blend of research-driven lecturing and humor.
